Replace the circular framing with a true full-bleed square portrait: completely REMOVE the circular outline, circular mint disc, white/ivory outside corners and any vignette. Extend the character's jacket and shoulders naturally to the left, right and bottom canvas edges. Fill the entire background all the way to all four square corners with one consistent pale mint color, with only extremely subtle paper texture. Keep the face centered and large, fit head comfortably inside frame. High-quality anime cel-shaded illustration matching the reference. Single square image, no border, no padding, no round corners, no text, no watermark. The result should look like a full square illustration rather than a circular badge pasted onto a square.
